# Project health

<!-- generated by `cargo xtask health --write` from the repository; do not edit -->

The state of the project, computed from the files in the repository: the readers and how well each is validated, the test corpus, the held-out benchmark, open findings, and the safety nets that let a new maintainer change a reader without breaking another. [maintaining.md](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/maintaining.md) explains how each number is used.

## Corpus

4767 manifest entries; 2214 development inputs of 97 formats from 759 depositors (distinct source records: a Zenodo record, a study, a repository) (326 without a download URL: synthetic fixtures and bundle members); 292 held-out inputs. Licences recorded: 26 distinct (every entry has one).

| tier | entries | declared size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| full | 120 | 48.8 GB |
| heldout | 730 | 6.6 GB |
| hold | 26 | 132.6 MB |
| smoke | 2010 | 1.1 GB |
| standard | 1881 | 26.1 GB |

## Assurance evidence

From `corpus/assurance/evidence.json` (development files only): 1979 files read; 1874 compared with an oracle, 1874 agree (100%); 1846 confirmed by an independent reader. 2423 distinct variant-feature values observed, 2264 of them validated (93%); the others make files that use them `partially_validated` or `unvalidated`.

Development files `info` cannot read (3): `pcrd-cfx-primerpickr` (bio-rad-pcrd), `gen5prt-elisa-reader` (plate), `softmax5-cuvette-spectra-s2` (plate).

## Held-out benchmark

Latest run: [heldout-2026-10-06d.md](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/benchmark/heldout-2026-10-06d.md) (292 held-out inputs never used for development; rules in [heldout.md](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/benchmark/heldout.md)).

| outcome | files |
| --- | --- |
| clean | 237 |
| clean (partial copy: check rightly exits 4) | 5 |
| disagrees | 36 |
| fails | 12 |
| reads, check/dump fail | 2 |

Assurance of those files: 102 partially validated, 12 refused, 32 unvalidated, 146 validated.

Held-out corpus-test results in the evidence (what the confidence rubric uses): 68 pass, 6 fail.

## Open findings

- New-variant intakes (`corpus/intake/`): none.
- Second-opinion disagreements adjudicated (`corpus/oracle/second/adjudications.toml`, 0 where neither reader was right): 26 whole-file entries, and 33 field entries that settle 123 per-file field differences ([second opinions](../../../docs/benchmark/second-opinions.md)).
- Corpus files whose oracle is known to disagree for a documented reason (`oracle_skip`): 18.
- Corpus entries whose licence or source is not yet confirmed (from intakes; tier `hold`, not fetched automatically): 0.
- Known upstream dependency bugs with reproducers (`fuzz/known-upstream/`): 6.
